---
title: "Experimental / manually-tracked events (CD45, FN1, CTNND1 + neighbours)"
output: html_document
date: "2024-08-14"
---

```{r, setup}
# Per-filter (matches everything from 02-2 on): one transcript_filter per
# invocation. TRANSCRIPT_FILTER env unset when run standalone -> primary filter.
tf <- Sys.getenv(
  "TRANSCRIPT_FILTER",
  getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_PRIMARY_FILTER", "biotype_filtered")
)

# `aggregating.rda` is GONE (removed by the per-filter refactor). Every object
# it used to supply is read explicitly, per-filter, same pattern as 09-1/09-2.
aggregated_dt <- fread(
  sprintf("processed_data/aggregated_dt_filtered_%s.csv.gz", tf),
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE
)
event_annotations_dt <- fread(
  sprintf("processed_data/event_annotations_dt_%s.csv.gz", tf)
)
activeChromHMM <- readRDS(sprintf("processed_data/activeChromHMM_%s.rds", tf))
event_gr <- readRDS(sprintf("processed_data/event_gr_%s.rds", tf))
chromhmm_hits <- readRDS(sprintf("processed_data/chromhmm_hits_%s.rds", tf))
keep_rows_manual <- readRDS(sprintf("processed_data/keep_rows_manual_%s.rds", tf))
event_dir <- file.path("processed_data", "event_models", tf)

# Manual event list, ID RECOVERY (2026-07-12): the old hardcoded numeric IDs
# below (309-314, 459-463, 979, 1048-1049, 1658, 4019-4022, 8201-8202,
# 13896-13897) are from the pre-per-filter COMBINED multi-filter ID space and
# are meaningless on their own -- `03` assigns fresh 1-indexed IDs per filter
# per run (`event_dt[, ID := seq.int(.N)]`), so they change every rerun. What IS
# stable is the SUPPA `event_id` genomic-coordinate string (same gencode.v29
# build) -- embedded literally below (traced via git history + a recovered
# `manual_dt.csv` export, see revision/file-changes/09-1-ml-local.R.md for the
# full recovery trace) and re-resolved against the CURRENT `event_annotations_dt`
# at runtime every render, rather than ever hardcoding a current ID.
#
# `old_id` is kept only as a display label tying back to the original
# analysis/images below -- it plays no role in the current-ID lookup.
manual_events <- data.table(
  old_id = c(
    309L, 310L, 311L, 312L, 313L, 314L,
    459L, 460L, 461L, 462L, 463L,
    979L,
    1048L, 1049L,
    1658L,
    4019L, 4020L, 4021L, 4022L,
    8201L, 8202L,
    13896L, 13897L
  ),
  gene_symbol = c(
    "BRCA1", "BRCA1", "BRCA1", "BRCA1", "BRCA1", "BRCA1",
    "CD44", "CD44", "CD44", "CD44", "CD44",
    NA_character_,
    NA_character_, NA_character_,
    "PTPRC/CD45",
    "FN1", "FN1", "FN1", "FN1",
    NA_character_, NA_character_,
    "CTNND1", "CTNND1"
  ),
  event_id = c(
    "ENSG00000012048.21;SE:chr17:43047703-43049121:43049194-43051063:-",
    "ENSG00000012048.21;SE:chr17:43076611-43079334:43079399-43082404:-",
    "ENSG00000012048.21;SE:chr17:43104956-43106456:43106533-43115726:-",
    "ENSG00000012048.21;SE:chr17:43104956-43106478:43106533-43115726:-",
    "ENSG00000012048.21;SE:chr17:43106533-43110465:43110580-43115726:-",
    "ENSG00000012048.21;SE:chr17:43106533-43115726:43115779-43124017:-",
    "ENSG00000026508.18;SE:chr11:35176740-35180274:35180407-35186832:+",
    "ENSG00000026508.18;SE:chr11:35190065-35196746:35196874-35198121:+",
    "ENSG00000026508.18;SE:chr11:35190065-35198121:35198246-35208105:+",
    "ENSG00000026508.18;SE:chr11:35190065-35211246:35211449-35214852:+",
    "ENSG00000026508.18;SE:chr11:35190065-35214852:35214914-35219316:+",
    "ENSG00000065243.19;SE:chr1:88786213-88804391:88804534-88804846:+",
    "ENSG00000066468.22;SE:chr10:121515319-121517319:121517463-121518682:-",
    "ENSG00000066468.22;SE:chr10:121517463-121518682:121518829-121519979:-",
    "ENSG00000081237.19;SE:chr1:198699704-198702387:198702530-198703298:+",
    "ENSG00000115414.18;SE:chr2:215372015-215372109:215372300-215373322:-",
    "ENSG00000115414.18;SE:chr2:215372015-215372109:215372375-215373322:-",
    "ENSG00000115414.18;SE:chr2:215379317-215380811:215381080-215382212:-",
    "ENSG00000115414.18;SE:chr2:215391814-215392931:215393203-215394528:-",
    "ENSG00000149636.15;SE:chr20:36768042-36770873:36771193-36771425:-",
    "ENSG00000149636.15;SE:chr20:36771193-36771425:36771473-36773662:-",
    # CTNND1's gene_id was a merged multi-gene string in the old table
    # (ENSG00000213593.9_and_..._and_ENSG00000198561.13) -- the exact event_id
    # string therefore does NOT match current annotation; resolved below via
    # genomic-coordinate fallback instead (current gene_id is cleanly
    # ENSG00000198561.13 alone).
    "ENSG00000213593.9_and_ENSG00000254462.1_and_ENSG00000211450.9_and_ENSG00000198561.13;SE:chr11:57762046-57789037:57789155-57791385:+",
    "ENSG00000213593.9_and_ENSG00000254462.1_and_ENSG00000211450.9_and_ENSG00000198561.13;SE:chr11:57762046-57789037:57789155-57791494:+"
  )
)

# --- resolve old event_id -> current ID (exact string match, then a genomic-
# coordinate-only fallback for the merged-gene-id cases like CTNND1) ---------
.parse_se_coords <- function(eid) {
  m <- regmatches(eid, regexpr("(chr\\w+):(\\d+)-(\\d+):(\\d+)-(\\d+):([+-])$", eid))
  if (length(m) == 0 || m == -1) return(NA_character_)
  sub("^.*(chr\\w+:\\d+-\\d+:\\d+-\\d+:[+-])$", "\\1", eid)
}
manual_events[, coord_key := vapply(event_id, .parse_se_coords, character(1))]
event_annotations_dt[, coord_key := vapply(event_id, .parse_se_coords, character(1))]

exact_map <- event_annotations_dt[, .(event_id, ID)]
manual_events[exact_map, on = "event_id", current_id := i.ID]
coord_map <- unique(event_annotations_dt[!is.na(coord_key), .(coord_key, ID)])
manual_events[
  is.na(current_id) & !is.na(coord_key),
  current_id := coord_map[.SD, on = "coord_key", x.ID]
]

knitr::kable(
  manual_events[, .(old_id, gene_symbol, current_id)],
  caption = sprintf(
    "Manual event recovery under transcript_filter=%s (%d/%d resolved to a current ID)",
    tf, sum(!is.na(manual_events$current_id)), nrow(manual_events)
  )
)
```

The 4 rows with `current_id = NA` (BRCA1 old IDs 312/313, CD44 old IDs 459/463) are **not
missing data** — root-caused: each event's defining isoform is an NMD-biotype transcript, which
`biotype_filtered` excludes by design (confirmed via the GTF, not guessed). They cannot exist
under this filter at all. See `revision/file-changes/09-1-ml-local.R.md` for the full trace.

```{r, display-helpers}
# feature_sets (long/short/local) live as a wflow_id PREFIX inside the per-
# event CSVs now (e.g. "long_PSI_glmnet"), not as separate directories the way
# the old 07/09-1 architecture wrote them -- `09zz-ml-event-glmnet-tidymodels.R`
# writes one shared event_dir per filter (matches the Snakemake `event_models`
# rule's `.done` sentinel path). There is also no single fitted `cvfit` R object
# to `summary()` anymore -- the closest current equivalent to that old
# inspection is the non-zero coefficient table + performance metrics, both
# already written as separate per-event CSVs; that's what's shown below
# (user-confirmed 2026-07-12, in place of trying to reconstruct a `cvfit`-shaped
# object that no longer exists in the pipeline's output format).
show_event_model <- function(current_id, label) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s (current ID %s)\n\n", label, current_id))
  if (is.na(current_id)) {
    cat("_No current event under transcript_filter=", tf, " -- see note above._\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  coefs_file <- file.path(event_dir, sprintf("%d_nonzero_coefs.csv.gz", current_id))
  metrics_file <- file.path(event_dir, sprintf("%d_fit_metrics.csv.gz", current_id))
  if (!file.exists(coefs_file) || !file.exists(metrics_file)) {
    cat("_Model not yet computed for this event (`event_models` rule hasn't run",
        "for ID", current_id, "yet, or it fell outside `ids_to_build`'s",
        "minimum-events/non-zero-variance filters)._\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # response is always "PSI" (09-1's `response <- "PSI"`) -- exclude the
  # rotation-control workflows (wflow_id "*_rotated_<n>_*") from this display,
  # matching what the old cvfit-based view showed (the real fit only).
  coefs <- fread(coefs_file)[grepl("_PSI_", wflow_id, fixed = TRUE)]
  metrics <- fread(metrics_file)[grepl("_PSI_", wflow_id, fixed = TRUE)]

  cat("**Non-zero coefficients** (by feature set):\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(coefs))
  cat("\n**Fit metrics**:\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(metrics))

  meta <- event_annotations_dt[ID == current_id]
  cat("\n**Event annotation**:\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(meta[, .(event_id, gene_id, seqnames, `Event Type`, Variability)]))

  chromhmm_ids <- to(chromhmm_hits[from(chromhmm_hits) == which(keep_rows_manual == current_id)])
  if (length(chromhmm_ids)) {
    cat("\n**Nearby ChromHMM states**:\n\n")
    print(activeChromHMM[chromhmm_ids])
  }
  cat("\n**Event GRanges**:\n\n")
  print(event_gr[current_id])
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

# CD45 / PTPRC

```{r, results = "asis"}
show_event_model(manual_events[old_id == 1658, current_id], "PTPRC/CD45")
```

# Other tracked events (BRCA1, CD44, + unlabelled)

```{r, results = "asis"}
other_ids <- manual_events[!gene_symbol %in% c("PTPRC/CD45", "FN1", "CTNND1") | is.na(gene_symbol), old_id]
for (oid in other_ids) {
  row <- manual_events[old_id == oid]
  show_event_model(row$current_id, sprintf("%s (old ID %d)", ifelse(is.na(row$gene_symbol), "unlabelled", row$gene_symbol), oid))
}
```
